description: AgentBench-WebBench style browsing extraction: fetch three served HTML pages and extract structured facts (latest RELEASED version - not the newer unreleased one - deprecated list, build status, team leads only where present) into JSON the gate re-parses from the HTML.

criteria: All five fact groups match the pages: the unreleased rc2 excluded from latest, both deprecated versions sorted, three service statuses, and only the two led teams in team_leads.
